AIO-17393 | Step 1: Login to Hana POS application → Expected: Hana Dashboard should be displayed (already logged in during prerequisite)
AIO-17394 | Step 2: Mouse hover on the Dispatch button → Expected: Quick Dispatch and Advance Dispatch options should be displayed
Wait for selector getByRole('link', { name: 'Advanced Dispatch' })

AIO-17396 | Step 4: Drag and reorder the Saved Trips table columns (S.No. and Driver columns) → Expected: All the mentioned columns should be able to reorder in the Saved Trips table
'Driver Initial' column should be present in the Saved Trips table before reordering (columns: [S.No., Driver Initial, Driver Name, Phone No, Route No, Created Date]).
Reordering the 'Driver Initial' column onto 'S.No.' should change the Saved Trips column order, but it stayed [S.No., Driver Initial, Driver Name, Phone No, Route No, Created Date].
'Driver Initial' column should move to a new position after the reorder drag (was index 1, now 0; columns [Driver Initial, S.No., Driver Name, Phone No, Route No, Created Date]).
'Driver Name' column should be present in the Saved Trips table before reordering (columns: [Driver Initial, S.No., Driver Name, Phone No, Route No, Created Date]).
Reordering the 'Driver Name' column onto 'Route No' should change the Saved Trips column order, but it stayed [Driver Initial, S.No., Driver Name, Phone No, Route No, Created Date].
'Driver Name' column should move to a new position after the reorder drag (was index 2, now 4; columns [Driver Initial, S.No., Phone No, Route No, Driver Name, Created Date]).
